items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: I saw Louis Jordan with his Tympani Five.

ctx.x: Yeah you don’t raid Duke’s band, do you?

Oh man, no, no, man. But anyhow with that auditorium during the war, you have everybody that came through there. I saw Louis Jordan with his Tympani Five. Oh who the heck else? Well I named off quite a few, who’s left?
I’m curious if your parents were — did they feel good about you pursuing music as a career?
